run_train_realfill: run the RealFill training script to fine-tune a Stable Diffusion inpainting model with LoRA
create_realfill_dataset: create a RealFillDataset that loads reference images, target images, and generates random masks for training
build_lora_config: build a LoRA configuration for UNet and text encoder with configurable rank, alpha, dropout, and target modules
test_validation_pipeline: test the validation pipeline by generating inpainted images using the trained RealFill model
summarize_make_mask: summarize the make_mask function that generates random rectangular masks for image inpainting training
